card.name: Inside people's names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a person's first or last name, often a name split into parts, in general web text. It sits just before the name ends and a verb or comma follows.

modes.label: Name ending
modes.description: The closing part of a split personal name, right before a verb or title.

modes.label: Surname after first name
modes.description: A surname that follows a first name, before a comma or verb.

card.writes: It slightly favors verbs like rode, posed or invested and disfavors words like include, suggesting a person is the subject of the next verb.
card.plain: It marks the end of a person's name in ordinary text, where a verb about what that person did tends to come next.
